d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how, in a transformative shift for the global diamond market, Botswana is doubling its ownership stake in De Beers from 15% to 30%, making it the company’s largest shareholder. Announcing the milestone in parliament, President Duma Boko confirmed Botswana’s official support for the Global Diamond Consortium—led by former De Beers CEO Gareth Penny—to acquire Anglo American’s 85% stake.
